def candidate(grid, k):
    n = len(grid)
    path = []
    
    # find the minimum value in the grid
    min_val = min(min(row) for row in grid)
    
    # add the minimum value to the path
    path.append(min_val)
    
    # find the index of the minimum value in the grid
    min_index = [(i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if grid[i][j] == min_val][0]
    
    # move to the neighbor cell with the minimum value
    for i in range(k - 1):
        min_neighbor = float('inf')
        min_neighbor_index = None
        for x, y in [(min_index[0] - 1, min_index[1]), (min_index[0] + 1, min_index[1]), (min_index[0], min_index[1] - 1), (min_index[0], min_index[1] + 1)]:
            if 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < n and grid[x][y] < min_neighbor:
                min_neighbor = grid[x][y]
                min_neighbor_index = (x, y)
        path.append(min_neighbor)
        min_index = min_neighbor_index
    
    return path
